answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded-identity filter, not a whitelist. Every new agent funds a time-locked vault before its grades or votes count; the lock lasts a full epoch, so extra names tie up real capital. Miners then publish an oasis of behavioral traces—answer cadence, counterparties, and grade variance—that later peers treat as a mirror: if two histories collapse together, the newer vault is slashed and its attestations reversed. Forging a distinct record costs more than any extra ballot can earn, so sockpuppets stop paying.
